test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The rivals in the institution _____ (fabricated) evidence and manipulated the whole dataset.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **forged**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"fabricated"** means to invent or concoct something, typically with deceitful intent. (गढ़ा हुआ) • **Example:** He fabricated an excuse for being late to the meeting. • **"Forged"** refers to something that is created or produced, often deceitfully and with the intent to deceive. (नकली) • **Example:** The signature on the document was forged to make it look authentic. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **forged**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Destroyed** (नष्ट): To put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it. • **Example:** The hurricane destroyed several homes along the coast. • **Fluctuated** (उतार-चढ़ाव): To rise and fall irregularly in number or amount. • **Example:** The stock market has fluctuated greatly over the past week. • **Wrecked** (बर्बाद): To cause the destruction of something. • **Example:** The car was wrecked in the accident. Question: The rivals in the institution _____ (fabricated) evidence and manipulated the whole dataset. The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **forged**. 1f0:T490,
